programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: När Claudia och Robin provborrar efter jade och inte hittar något, kan inte ens företagets geologer skapa en gemensam plan.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia, Robin och teamet kämpar för att få upp sin tunga utrustning upp på ett berg innan stigande floder gör det omöjligt att ta sig till gruvområdet.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Spänningarna växer när teamet kämpar för att få den tunga utrustningen uppför en lerig, stenig 120 km lång stig för projektet att skapa ett nytt jadebrott uppe på en bergstopp.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Teamet kämpar för att ta sina maskiner över kraftiga floder för att skapa sin nya bergstoppsbelägna jadegruva.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Alan är övertygad om att det finns jade under en vattenfylld grop på deras territorium Dynasty.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Robin kämpar mot fysikens lagar för att se till att få ett enormt nytt boendehus för deras nya territorium Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Jade City-teamet förföljs av stor otur och alla kommer på unika lösningar för att försöka jaga bort demonerna.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Alla blir upprymda när de äntligen börjar gräva upp utlovande gröna stenblock som besättningen tror är värda miljoner.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Spänningarna kokar över när de utländska investerarna oväntat kommer förbi för att inspektera arbetet på gruvplatsen Wolverine och Alan försöker skipa fred.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: När de äntligen hittar några lovande stenblock vid Wolverinegruvan, upptäcker teamet att de kan ha brutit mot gruvdriftsreglerna.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Spänningen stiger när slutet av gruvsäsongen närmar sig och teamet i Jade City blir angelägna om att hitta det gäckande stenblocket värt miljontals dollar.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Minusgrader utmanar gruvarbetarna i Jade City som har bråttom för att hitta jackpotten – en jadesten som är tillräckligt stor för att imponera på investerarna – innan säsongen är slut.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia och Robins oprövade maskiner börjar gå sönder på den brutala färden upp till Wolverine-gruvan.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Teamet försöker korsa forsande floder under sin marsch med sina maskiner upp till gruvan, men Josh hamnar på efterkälken i sin problembenägna grävmaskin.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Josh blir strandsatt på den långa leden till Wolverine-gruvan när bultar skakas loss från hans grävmaskin, och han kan inte ringa efter hjälp.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Gruvsäsongen börjar och medan jaden visar sig svårhittad, förvandlas en lastbilsolycka till en lönsam händelse för Jade City.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Guy blir ansvarig för Wolverine, där upplärningen av en ny arbetare hotar att stå i vägen för hans uppdrag att hitta säsongens första jade.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Precis när teamet på Wolverine skärper sina säkerhetsrutiner kollapsar den nya arbetaren Jay, vilket exponerar sprickorna i deras nödberedskap.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Josh blir strandsatt i den nya grävmaskinen samtidigt som ett lager av värdelösa stenar gör att Claudia börjar överväga en ny gruvstrategi.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Alan tar med sig en grupp köpare till Jade City vilket skapar panikläge i Claudias team för att hitta säsongens första säljbara jadeblock.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Medan besättningen kämpar sig genom lera för att hitta ett stenblock som är värt en miljon dollar, riskerar Josh att förlora utrustning för halv miljon dollar när han försöker dra upp sin lastbil ur ett slukhål.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Teamet hittar säsongens bästa jadeblock, men riskerar att minska dess värde när de försöker kapa bort alla frakturer.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudias son Justin visar att han har en näsa för jade, medan Scrappy Larry, Robin och Josh kämpar för att bogsera sin trasiga lastbil upp från spåret till Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: En körning av tillhörigheter tvingar ut Robin och Justin på ett sista försök att leta efter jadestenar för att rädda säsongen medan Scrappy Larry har bråttom för att få en dieseltank ombyggd.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudias satsning på att driva en arbetsgrupp i Jade City hotas när septiktanken backar in i deras dricksvatten.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Med tidig ankomst av det kalla vädret och med skulder som hopar sig, knuffar, släpar och skjuter besättningen på en maffig och potentiellt säsongsvinnande sten till lägret.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Med årets mest lovande stenblock under sågen på Wolverine, kör Josh och R2 i diket med sin lastbil, vilket även drabbar Claudia och teamet.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Loppet pågår för att ta sig bort från Wolverine-lägret innan snön täcker allt.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia blir tvungen att köra stenbilen när hennes besättning kämpar sig uppför den steniga stigen till deras bergstoppsbelägna jadeläger, Wolverine

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Spänningarna kulminerar när Claudia, Robin och teamet försöker transportera människor och utrustning till det avlägsna jadelägret.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia och Robin försöker imponera på sina nya affärspartners men de första dagarna på deras nya område, Bullion Creek, är krävande.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Säsongens första stora stenblock transporteras tillbaka till lägret och sätts under sågen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Justin skyndar sig för att inmuta ett område efter att han snubblat över ett fantastiskt jadefynd, men andra gruvarbetare närmar sig.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudias nya partnerskap blir lidande när Justin och teamet distraheras av att försöka flytta ett gigantiskt stenblock som kan vara värt en förmögenhet.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Efter att ha hamnat i konflikt med sina affärspartners, tävlar Claudia och Robin om att starta om gruvdriften vid Wolverine, men blir stoppade av ett överraskande hinder.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Teamet kämpar för att få igång Dynastys jadebrott trots bristfällig utrustning.

programme.title: Matlock: The Dame
programme.desc: When Matlock is slapped by an attractive older woman in a restaurant, Ben recalls to Julie the story of his first case – the murder of the man who put him through law school.

programme.title: Matlock: The Suspect (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the aid of a young socialite accused of murdering her older husband for money.

programme.title: Matlock: The Suspect (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the aid of a young socialite accused of murdering her older husband for money.

programme.title: Matlock: The Defense
programme.desc: After witnessing a violent argument between his parents, a distraught young man murders his abusive father.

programme.title: Matlock: The Game Show
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the defense of popular game show host Dennis Blake who’s accused of the murder of his successful, yet despised mega-millionaire producer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Foursome
programme.desc: A brash multimillionaire, Ellis Blake is held in the slaying of Jeffrey Holden, a handsome, young man who intended to marry Ellis’ daughter – without his blessing or consent.

programme.title: Matlock: The Picture (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock’s search for evidence to prove his client innocent of killing her husband uncovers a ring of counterfeiters who will pay any price, including murder, to keep their secret. Ben’s investigation uncovers ties to the mob.

programme.title: Matlock: The Outcast (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock’s faith in his ability as a top-notch attorney is completely eroded when he’s dismissed by a client and replaced by a younger lawyer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Outcast (Part 2)
programme.desc: During his fishing trip, Matlock encounters the small, unfriendly town of Lone Pine as he attempts to solve the mysterious death of a young farmhand and uncover a town-wide coverup.

programme.title: Matlock: The Abduction
programme.desc: While attending a UCLA Law seminar, Matlock and Michelle end up in a dangerous dilemma. After giving Matlock inside information regarding an upcoming hit his former law school classmate is involved in a fatal hit and run.

programme.title: Matlock: Mr. Awesome
programme.desc: Matlock defends Anne Johnson, a single mother who’s been accused of murdering her recently estranged boyfriend.

programme.title: Matlock: The Evening News (Part 1)
programme.desc: A phony story is planted on the nightly news when a corrupt land developer pays off the on-air talent but when the producer fakes his own death, the anchorwoman unwittingly helps him along, never realizing it’s somebody else she killed.

programme.title: Matlock: The Evening News (Part 2)
programme.desc: Hired to defend an innocent newscaster, Matlock is baffled until evidence turns up that puts him on the trail of the real killer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Assassination (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock’s daughter’s surprise visit home is interrupted when a judge, on a Blue Ribbon panel investigating the assassination of the town Mayor, is accused of sexual assault and seeks Matlock’s counsel.

programme.title: Matlock: The Assassination (Part 2)
programme.desc: When his daughter is jailed for contempt Matlock takes over her case. Now it is up to him to uncover the truth behind a sinister cover-up that involves high government officials, including the Chief of Police, in a child pornography ring and a murder.

programme.title: Matlock: The Vacation (Part 1)
programme.desc: When Matlock and his daughter Leanne arrive at a seaside resort to plan their new law partnership, they discover the manager has been murdered.

programme.title: Matlock: The Vacation (Part 2)
programme.desc: While vacationing with his daughter, Matlock tries to solve the murder of the hotel manager at their seaside resort.

programme.title: Matlock: The Legacy (Part 2)
programme.desc: Young Brian Martell is accused of murdering a famous playwright – just as his father was charged with murdering the playwright’s father forty years ago! In untangling a web of secrets and adultery, Matlock and his father uncover the shocking truth.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: Hitlers Dödspatruller
programme.desc: När Nazityskland invaderade Polen 1939 och Sovjetunionen 1941 följde särskilda insatsgrupper (Einsatzgruppen) i den tyska arméns fotspår.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Gatling Gun, designed to change 19th-century battlefields, now reigns supreme in the skies as a high-speed offensive weapon. With a 150-year legacy of havoc it continues to be a formidable force.

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Exhibition and Spectacle
programme.desc: The girls meet with TV star, June Sarpong to learn interview skills and are judged by undercover magazine journalists. The claws are out as the girls critique each other during the challenge. Tension in the house builds.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Drama and Performance
programme.desc: This week the girls learn some new choreography with Supple and in the photoshoot the girls are told they are to pose for an album cover. Lisa Snowdon treats everyone to cocktails with The Bar Wizards -finalists on last years Britain's Got Talent.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Intelligence and Originality
programme.desc: The models face an acting challenge which includes a steamy kissing scene with guest actor Guy Burnet. The photoshoot this week is a couture shot where each girl had to portray a different emotion.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Imagination and Creativity
programme.desc: The girls pose as different types of mannequines for their photoshoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Stamina and Endurance
programme.desc: The girls are put through a series of circus acts and asked to model on plinths in London's streets. The girls also pose for beauty shots in Zandra Rhodes dresses in the style of sporting events.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Beauty and Cover Girl
programme.desc: The girls start the week by attending a casting session with Sadie Frost and Jemima French. They meet up with Caroline Barnes and Sophie Beresiner for a beauty editorial and the photoshoot is for the cover of Company Magazine.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Semi-Finals
programme.desc: In the penulimate episode of Cycle 4, the girls arive in South Africa and they participate in an African themed photoshoot. In the end one girl is sent home to the UK.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Finals
programme.desc: In the finale the girls do one last photoshoot with animals in the South African bush. Then, after one girl is eliminated, the girls participate in an African runway show and 'Britain's Next Top Model' is crowned.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The contestants arrive at the house with a champagne reception greeted by host Lisa. They complete an assault course and a catwalk challenge featuring clothing by Ed Hardy. The photo challenge sees the remaining girls in an army inspired shoot with Huggy.
programme.sub-title: The Girls Go To Boot Camp

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: This weeks challenge is to film an advert on the Millennium bridge wearing Elizabeth Emanuel bridal wear. The photoshoot challenge asks the girls to pose naked in a bath of water filled with mangos for Simple Cosmetics.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Bibbi är sjuksköterska och ska snart gå i pension, men med sina skulder kommer hon inte att kunna gå i pension vid 67 års ålder. Hennes hus är fullt av kläder, smycken och tomma champagneflaskor. Kommer hon att kunna ändra sin livsstil?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Roy Erik köper och säljer klockor varannan vecka och experterna har aldrig sett ett sådant slöseri. Han köper på impuls och säljer med förlust. Med sin höga skuld kommer han aldrig att kunna köpa ett eget hus.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Helene har en bra inkomst, men i stället för att lägga undan pengar shoppar hon. Hon lägger 13.000 norska kronor i månaden bara på nätshopping och drömmen om att köpa ett eget hus känns avlägsen.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Arild blandar ihop sin privatekonomi med sitt företag och har därför tappat kontrollen. Han har skulder på långt över en miljon kronor. Arild är en skicklig tatuerare, men hur kan han rädda sin ekonomi?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Hilde slösar bort sin lön som lastbilschaufför på sitt bilintresse. Hon struntar i räkningarna, kylskåpet är tomt, elen är på väg att stängas av och skulderna växer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Ellinor har sålt sitt hus och är på väg att starta om sitt liv. Trots en bra inkomst har hon det kämpigt. Experterna följer med henne under flyttprocessen och blir chockade över hur mycket pengar som läggs på onödiga inköp.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2501
programme.desc: Ørjan har köpt och sålt över 100 bilar under 13 års tid och hans tomt är full av olika fordon. Han har en bra lön, men spenderar desto mer, och när kontot ekar tomt handlas det på kredit.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2502
programme.desc: Else har skatteskulder och riskerar att bli av med sitt hus. De höga elpriserna och Elses överdrivna konsumtion av kaffe, mat och mobilspel tar över hennes budget och får framtiden att se mörk ut.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2503
programme.desc: Odins liv vändes på sin kant när han sjuk i cancer, och nu hindrar skulderna från tiden innan och under sjukdomen honom från att bygga det liv han vill ha.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Sverre och experterna blir chockade då ett brev dyker upp om att Sverres hus måste säljas. Sverre har valt festandet före att bygga klart sitt hus, och har använt fakturor för att tända brasor.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2505
programme.desc: Daniel dricker 3 liter läsk om dagen och gamla lån har hindrat honom och Mona från att bilda familj. Mona tror att Daniel spenderat små summor på vadslagning men det visar sig handla om mer pengar.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2506
programme.desc: Ulrik har tagit stora lån för att etablera sig med familjen men har tappat kontrollen och får en otrevlig överraskning när experterna anländer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Madeleine älskar inredning och hennes garderob är full av nyinköpta kläder. När Madeleine vill ha något nytt så köper hon det. Hon lever över sina tillgångar och de dyra lånen hopar sig.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Robin slösar bort alla sina pengar på dyra hobbies. Han har precis gjort slut med Madeleine från förra avsnittet, och med hennes skyhöga skulder och överdrivna utgifter är hans nya liv svårt.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dave traded for his dream 1957 Corvette more than three decades ago, but his plans to build it have so far come to nothing. Ken chose a rare 1954 Kaiser Darrin from his father’s collection and its now on FantomWorks to reverse the hands of time.

programme.title: The Ride Life
programme.desc: Sung returns to his home town LA, the car culture capital of the world. This is where Sung feels the most pressure to be on his game. But in the car scene, Sung meets old friends, discovers new inspirations, and finds a way to face life's challenges.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Cuda 'Tat
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Steve has only driven his prized 1969 Camaro Z28 at five miles an hour, but he wants it to be a muscle car beast. Scott owns a rare matching numbers 1964 Corvette that he wants brought back to life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1965 Cadillac Deville and a 1984 Monte Carlo. The 'caddie' is so full of leaves and rat droppings that it's a health hazard. The Monte Carlo is intended as an anniversary present.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Ben wants a partial restoration for his father’s 1962 Maserati, but Dan sees only one solution – turning this heirloom into one of the rarest survivor cars on earth. Raymond and Diane only want one thing for their worn out 1966 bug – perfection.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Chris wants the 1950 F1 Truck he remembers from high school and Dean wants the 1968 Lincoln Continental he drove with his dad.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Charles wants Dan to find him a 1967 Corvette with a set-up that’s rare as hen’s teeth. Bob’s 1973 Cuda has been stored for most of its life – but even in storage time takes a heavy toll.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: This Roadrunner gives me a Hemi
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.
programme.sub-title: This Roadrunner gives me a Hemi

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas take you on a tour of what is happening in the shop. Replacing the front end of a 64 Corvette resto mod. Painting racing stripes on a 67 442 convertible. A yellow Camaro underneath the hood of this car.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan's team take on the restorations of a 1966 Volkswagen Beetle and a 1976 TR6 convertible. The TR6 looks bad, but Dan sees hidden potential for it to become a rare 'survivor' car that still has its original paint and fixtures.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: FantomWorks finish the build of the ultimate Mustang Sleeper, a California Special powered by a Coyote Aluminator. Phil wants a 1949 Chevy Pick-up, but the truck is a disassembled jigsaw puzzle with a lot of pieces missing.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas are working in the paint booth on the Malicious Intent. The 1966 Mustang is sanding out the car to get it ready for the paint booth. The 86 Camaro is being converted into a sniper system under the hood.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: The team at Muscle Cars of Texas will add primer to the frame of a half million dollar 1963 Corvette Z06. This 65 Mustang had a tune up and its ready for a test drive. A new costumer has dropped off a 1968 Corvette for a restoration project.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: John thinks his 1958 Corvette is ‘mostly original’ but Dan finds a mismatched assortment of poor-quality parts and bad repairs. Chelsea wants FantomWorks to fix up a rare 1971 Fury for her father, Rikk. The car has previously caught on fire 3 times!

programme.title: Jet Truck
programme.desc: The Darnell's celebrate their return home by blowing off some pent-up explosive redneck frustration while Brooke tries to keep something very special under wraps.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: 67 Hemi GTX Convertible Resurrected
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Kolin asks Dan to repair his smashed up 1973 Corvette, but Dan finds major problems that existed before the accident. Jim wants Dan to build him an asphalt crushing 1970 Challenger convertible by adding a 426 Hemi with all the fixin’s.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team are priming the 1972 Nova to help prevent it from rusting. We take a look back at all the cool stuff that has happened in the shop.

programme.title: The Ride Life
programme.desc: Sung heads to the UK, home to some of the world's most iconic car brands like Land Rover, Rolls Royce, and Jaguar. It's a land rich in history, but as Sung explores the car culture's grass roots, he finds the people who make it so memorable.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Grin and Bear a 'Cuda
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1965 Mustang fastback and a 1951 Studebaker truck. The mustang is for a friend whose plans are far bigger than his budget, and the Studebaker needs a unique design to make it a world-class show vehicle.

programme.title: Harlequin: This Matter of Marriage
programme.desc: Arkitekterna Hallie och Donnalee driver ett stort byggprojekt för en excentrisk miljardär, Adam Barr. Hallie, som har letat efter sin drömman, hittar honom plötsligt i grannhuset. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Hard to Forget
programme.desc: Privatdetektiven Max Warner är övertygad om att Sandra Applewhites död inte var en olyckshändelse utan att hennes make John Gilman mördade henne. När han möter Sandras tvillingsyster Nicky ber han henne om hjälp. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter

programme.title: Harlequin: Diamond Girl
programme.desc: Playboy-advokaten Denny Montana ger aldrig sin sjaskiga biträdande jurist Claire Bernard en andra blick. Men när han börjar se en oslipad diamant i Claire, börjar han förvandla henne till en förtjusande skönhet. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Waiting Game
programme.desc: Sarah och Amy, bästa vänner sedan universitetet, anordnar sin första konstutställning i en liten stad i New England. När gåtfulla främlingar kommer in i deras liv och romantik uppstår utvecklas det utmaningar. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter

programme.title: Harlequin: Loving Evangeline
programme.desc: När Robert får veta om sin brors båtolycka ger han sig ut för att hämta kroppen och möter Evie Shaw, ägare till marinan där hans bror hyrde båten. Han blir besatt av sin brors misstänkta död ... och av Evie. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Recipe for Revenge
programme.desc: Cateringfirman Carly Westin går med på att förbereda en festmåltid för en vän som vill imponera på en man. Men paret blir dödat när hon är i köket. När polisutredaren Jack blir inblandad måste han skydda Carly. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: När den oroliga Dominique ber sin bokälskande syster Kimberly att anta rollen som en glamorös parisisk modell i en månad, tvekar Kimberly. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: När Lisa vaknar upp på sjukhuset minns hon ingenting: vem hon är, hennes man Pauls avsikt att skilja sig från henne eller att hon blev svårt misshandlad och lämnad att dö i en gränd. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties
programme.desc: Anne Marie Kerr misstänker att hennes bror Alans död inte är en olycka och bestämmer sig för att utreda saken. Hon börjar arbeta för den mäktiga familjen som kan vara inblandad i Alans död. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I detta avsnitt av Ridiculousness träffar Rob, Steelo och gästvärden Lolo Wood ofokuserade fäder med 'Distraherade pappahjärnor', spelar ett riskfyllt spel medan de utför 'Djärva bärgningar' och visar sina prutt-skills i 'Gastrick'

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness räknar Rob, Steelo och gästvärden Lolo Wood ihop kostnaden för 'Dyra barn', snubblar på akrobatikutövare som ägnar sig åt 'Plötslig cirkus' och upplever smärtsamma firanden i 'Dåliga födelsedagar'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness kastar sig Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood huvudstupa in i saker i 'Kraftskallar', förstör sina golfklubbor i 'Dags för nya klubbor' och inser riskerna med 'Samåkning på natten'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness utforskar Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim och Lolo Wood eld i sportvärlden i 'Flamsport', får reda på hur farliga dörrar kan vara i 'Skruven är lös' och blir överraskade av 'Oväntade raketer'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness krockar Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood med stillastående objekt i Parkerad smärta', upptäcker att trafiken ibland är bisarr i 'Motorvägsstopp' och upplever faran med 'Vildsinta tjurar'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness stöter Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood på farliga voltare i 'Voltmedvetenhet', känner smärtan när en cykel pajar i 'Billiga cyklar' och upptäcker att hissar och sprit inte passar så bra ihop i 'Hiss-packade'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness försöker Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood att muntra upp folk i 'Vinterdepp', tar reda på vad som händer i 'Ansikte mot stängsel', och sabbar perfekta ögonblick med 'Sorgliga förlovningsfilmer'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness är Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood av 'Konfunderade konsertbesökare', får smaka på 'Sömnsnacks' och undviker att vara såna som 'Rusar mot mötet'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness får Rob, Steelo och gästvärden Lolo Wood känna på hårda tag när de flyttar ut och blir 'Ömma flyttare', träffar nya kollegor i 'Dum på jobbet' och lär sig att det är okej att ge upp i 'Vi lägger av'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness dyker Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim och Lolo Wood rakt ner spenaten i 'Käka gräs', blir vältränade tillsammans med muskliga hundar i 'Gymhundar' och går under nollstrecket för 'Djupfryst glädje'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness skapar Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood sina egna halkfaror i 'Självsladdare', tittar förbi på gymmet för att bli 'Boxad av säck' och utmanar höjdskräcken ordentligt i 'Galna höjder'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I dethär avsnittet av Ridiculousness tar sig Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood lätt över 'Skyddsstängsel', behöver en detalj i 'Bil-varelser' och testar sin halsningsförmåga i 'Halsning kommer upp igen'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I detta Ridiculousness träffar Rob, Steelo, Lolo Wood och Dee Snider rebeller i 'Tänker inte tåla det', bevittnar band som stretar på i 'Kommer inte slå igenom' och upplever sorgen i att spilla ut kaffet i 'Kaffetragedier'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I kvällens avsnitt av Ridiculousness tar Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood en titt på konsekvenserna av att inte se skyltar i 'Skyltblind', lär sig udda fakta i 'Tekniskt sett sant' och får erfara hur galet det kan gå i 'Galnare och galnare'.

programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E10 - My Three Crichtons

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E11 - Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss
programme.desc: On a planet about to crown its new monarch. The problem is the Princess cannot ascend unless she finds a genetically compatible mate.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E11 - Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E12 - Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
programme.desc: The Queen offers Crichton a choice; marry her daughter the crown princess, or she'll turn him over to Scorpius.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E12 - Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E13 - Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
programme.desc: John Crichton faces eighty years as a statue. That is, until the Scarran Cargn decapitates the statue and drops the head into a vat of acid.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E13 - Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E14 - Beware Of Dog
programme.desc: The crew bring aboard an alien tracker to remove some creatures that came aboard hidden in some cargo.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E14 - Beware Of Dog

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E15 - Won't Get Fooled Again
programme.desc: Crichton has returned to Earth. Or has he always been on Earth all this time? People from his past and present appear.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E15 - Won't Get Fooled Again

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E16 - The Locket
programme.desc: A temporal distortion traps Aeryn and John on a planet's surface, where they live out the rest of their lives.

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E17 - The Ugly Truth
programme.desc: Crais and Talyn return. The crew are put on trial for an attack that Talyn made on an alien ship.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E17 - The Ugly Truth

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E18 - A Clockwork Nebari
programme.desc: A Nebari group comes aboard Moya and attempts to mind cleanse everyone using a drug. Pilot and Rygel are the only two who can resist the effects.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E18 - A Clockwork Nebari

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E19 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 1: A Not So Simple Plan
programme.desc: D'Argo finally gets a lead on his son, Jothee. He will do anything to get him back, but Jothee will be sold as a slave.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E19 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 1: A Not So Simple Plan

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E20 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 2: With Friends Like These
programme.desc: With the loot from the Depository heist at hand, D'Argo anxiously waits to make contact with the Slave Traders.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E20 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 2: With Friends Like These

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E21 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B
programme.desc: The crew is going to break into the depository to free Crichton. Crichton is being tortured for wormhole technology.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E21 - Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S2 E22 - Die Me, Dichotomy
programme.desc: Wealthy from their bank heist, Moya's crew heads straight to meet with Diagnosan Tocot, a famous surgeon whom they hope can heal Moya's burns.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S2 E22 - Die Me, Dichotomy

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E1 - Season Of Death
programme.desc: D'Argo and Stark try to heal John, left with his head open on an operating table, while Scorpius attempts to avoid discovery.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E1 - Season Of Death

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E2 - Suns And Lovers
programme.desc: Moya docks at a commerce station so the crew can spend some of their money. Disaster strikes when the station is hit by a storm.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E2 - Suns And Lovers

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E3 - Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programme.desc: Moya approaches a wormhole, gets pulled in and fused to another ship.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E3 - Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E4 - Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programme.desc: The crew works out a way of getting free from the other ship and out of the wormhole.
programme.sub-title: Farscape: S3 E4 - Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S3 E5 - Different Destinations
programme.desc: Stark accidentally sends himself, Crichton, Aeryn. D'Argo and Jool are back in time where they alter the timeline.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana continue their investigation on Jordan Collier's plan for mankind. Dennis Ryland returns to NTAC. Isabelle is seriously injured when she takes a classroom hostage.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A high school student develops an ability after injecting promicin. Tom visits Isabelle in jail, while Diana searches for her missing sister. Following the advice of a young woman named Cassie, Kyle is able to wake Shawn from his coma.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for a person who has the ability to make people's worst fears come to life. Danny seeks Shawn's help in finding a promicin shot. Cassie leads Kyle to a book that contains a prophecy about Jordan Collier.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Audrey Parker develops the ability to astral project herself. However, after she is murdered, Audrey attempts to use her ability to lead Tom and Diana to her killer.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: April's new ability endangers her life. Shawn is approached to run for public office, while Kyle helps Isabelle.
programme.sub-title: The Truth And Nothing But The Truth

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: After realizing Tom knows he is promicin-positive, Kyle joins Jordan in a remote town called Evanston. Tom follows Kyle, and learns the remarkable truth about Evanston: all of its residents are promicin-positive.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for Curtis Peck, a 4400 film maker whose ability allows him to `know` the truth behind historical conspiracies. Jordan tries to recruit Shawn into his movement.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Jordan and his followers annex a run-down part of Seattle, dubbing it `Promise City`. Shawn's campaign for city council is threatened when a woman accuses him of using his healing ability in exchange for sex.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A lockdown at NTAC threatens the lives of Tom, Diana, Meghan, Shawn, Kyle, Jordan, Isabelle, Maia, Marco, PJ and Brady when they wakeup inside the building with no recollection of how they got there.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Richard kidnaps Isabelle from Collier's Promise City. Richard hopes to start a new life with his daughter. Elsewhere, Tess has taken over a 1950's diner, and Shawn is asked to intervene.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The Director of National Intelligence pressures NTAC to pursue Richard and Isabelle. Richard is visited by his dead wife, Lily.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A computer virus attacks a large software company owned by a suspected member of The Marked. Maia visits Promise City and receives an unexpected birthday gift.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Isabelle works with Tom in order to get close to Jordan. Shawn recruits a small band of promicin positives to break Kevin out of Promise City. Tom and Diana face off in the backroom of a grocery store, and Diana is forced to shoot Tom.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Danny Farrell's newfound ability to spread promicin leads to several hundred deaths, including his mother. With Seattle in chaos, NTAC is forced to accept Promise City's offer of help.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A comet is due to pass by Earth, but its trajectory changes to a collision course, causing widespread panic. When the comet appears to slow down - as if it's coming in for a landing - 4,400 people are deposited in an explosion over Highland Beach.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 returnees have been missing from months to years. None have any memory of where they've been, none have aged, and a small number are beginning to manifest paranormal abilities. Tom Baldwin and Diana Skouris are appointed to investigate.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Carl Morrissey is a lowly supermarket employee who happens to be one of the 4400. He uses his new found powers - enhanced reflexes and strength - to become a vigilante and fight crime in his neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: The New and Improved Carl Morrissey

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are sent out to investigate a homicide that resembles the MO of a serial killer who was never caught nor heard of for 21 years. The first suspect is Oliver Knox, a member of the 4400.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 are attacked by a series of bombings after Barbara Yates makes their names and addresses known to the public. Tom, Diana and Dennis try to put an end to the bombings, while at the same time Tom is coping with Kyle's erratic behaviour.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom is furious after finding out that Lytell has taken his son Kyle into custody. Diana offers to help him in getting Kyle back. Meanwhile, Richard suspects that Collier is trying to take control of Lily's life.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: After a daring escape, Seth leads the Fuller's RV to the border crossing while an irrational fear takes hold of Richie.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: The Geckos and Fullers get more than they bargained for when they enter the Titty Twister; Seth senses his deal with Carlos may be slipping away.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Santánico Pandemonium takes the stage as the Gecko brothers and the Fuller family sit down to watch the performance of a lifetime.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: As Santánico attempts to sway Richie to her cause, Freddie confronts Carlos about his destiny and the temple's mysterious past.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: To free Santánico, Seth and Richie must face the labyrinth within the temple. Meanwhile, Freddie uncovers a new lead in the cartel-killer case.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Seth and Richie defeat the labyrinth, only to find they've been double-crossed. Meanwhile, the Fullers confront their demons.

programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!

programme.desc: Henry får en Schwoz-skabt androide til at deltage i familiemiddagen, så Henry selv kan tage til årets MMA-kamp med Charlotte og Ray.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Gravalvorligt
programme.desc: Ray begynder at opføre sig mærkeligt, og da Henry og Charlotte undersøger, hvad der er galt, får de sig en overraskelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Voldkopper
programme.desc: Piper får en mystisk sygdom, så Kaptajn Mand må rejse tilbage til 1700-tallet, for at finde den eneste kur.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jeg Kender din Hemmelighed
programme.desc: Henry har fået en mystisk besked fra en, og er bekymret for om hans hemmelige identitet er blevet afsløret.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tidsnarreren
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen og Kaptajn-mand kæmper mod tidsnarreren, ryger Faredrengen uheldigvis ind i hans tidsmaskine og gennemlever derefter den samme dag om og om igen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Faren Begynder
programme.desc: Henry Hart er en almindelig dreng i ottende klasse, indtil han bliver håndlanger for superhelten Kaptajn Mand, hvilket han skal holde hemmeligt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Faren Begynder
programme.desc: Henry Hart er en almindelig dreng i ottende klasse, indtil han bliver håndlanger for superhelten Kaptajn Mand, hvilket han skal holde hemmeligt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Mere Fare, Flere Problemer
programme.desc: Henry prøver at forene sig med sin nye rolle som Faredrengen, og han kæmper med at få både bekæmpelse af kriminalitet, skole, familie og venner til at gå op.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hemmeligheden Slipper ud
programme.desc: Henrys liv som Faredrengen trues, da Charlotte bliver mere mistænksom over de hemmeligheder, han gemmer på.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tårer fra den Lystige Bille
programme.desc: Da Kaptajn-mand mistersin uovervindelighed, bliver han bange for at bekæmpe kriminalitet. Det er op til Faredrengen at sørge for Swellviews sikkerhed og finde ud af, hvordan Kaptajn-mand får sine kræfter tilbage.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vikaren
programme.desc: Da en mistænkelig ny elev dukker op på skolen, er Charlotte og Henry sikker på, at han har skumle planer. Kaptajn-mand bliver undercover vikar for at finde ud af mere.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fare-Jasper
programme.desc: Da Jasper klæder sig ud som Faredrengen til Halloween, går han for vidt og bliver forvekslet med den rigtige. Nu er det op til den rigtige Faredrengen og Kaptajn-mand at redde ham.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Månestenen
programme.desc: Henry kommer i vanskeligheder hjemme, da en sten fra det ydre rum viser sig, at være mere end først antaget.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Den Faldne Fødselsdagspige.
programme.desc: Henry bliver ikke inviteret til en fødselsdagsfest, fordi han bliver beskyldt for at have skubbet fødselaren ud fra hendes tag det foregående år. Kaptajn Mand træder til for at rense Henrys navn.

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Lidt for God Spiller

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry Menneskebæst
programme.desc: Henry har en vigtig date, men tingene går ikke helt som planlagt, da han ved et uheld kommer i kontakt med en sær maskine i Mandehulen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Usynlige Brad
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mands ven Brad, der ved et uheld for flere år siden blev usynlig, kommer på besøg. Der går ikke længe før alle er blevet trætte af ham.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Afsløreren
programme.desc: Henry og Ray forsøger at stoppe en yderst irriterende forbryder, der kalder sig for Afsløreren. Piper når grænsen, i forsøget på at komme med i en utroligt populær Kaptajn Mand fanklub.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Præmietyveri
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand får Henry med i hans yndlings gameshow, Spin og Vind, i forsøget på at nå til bunds i en række forbrydelser. Men Henry ender med selv at blive offer for den samme slags forbrydelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Supervulkanen
programme.desc: Da en supervulkan under Swellview ser ud til at kunne gå i udbrud, bliver Henry og Ray overbeviste om, at Verden snart går under. Piper er overbevist om at hun har glutenallergi.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vold & Valentinsdag
programme.desc: Da pigen Henry er vild med, tager på date med en anden fyr på Valentinsdag, bygger Schwoz en androide, der kan hjælpe Henry med at gøre pigen jaloux. Ray tager på en ubehagelig date med en af Henrys lærere.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fanget i Kælderen
programme.desc: Henry, Charlotte og Rays sjove planer bliver aflyst, da Jasper kommer til at aktivere nød-nedlukningen i Skidt og Kanel.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Elevatorkysset
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen redder Bianca ender de med at kysse. Henry har det fint med det, indtil han indser at Bianca kyssede Faredrengen - og ikke Henry. Det mener Henry er det samme som at have været ham utro.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Manden i huset
programme.desc: Da Henrys mor får sin pung stjålet, beslutter Kaptajn Mand sig for at flytte hjem til Henrys familie, for at beskytte dem. Men Kaptajn Mand tager rollen som manden i huset lidt for alvorligt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Drømmefangerne
programme.desc: En skurks drømmestråle rammer Henry og spærrer ham inde i en drømmetilstand, som kun Charlotte kan redde ham ud fra.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Superhelt i Stuearrest
programme.desc: Da Henry bliver taget i at snige sig ud om aftenen, får han stuearrest. Charlotte overtager hans rolle som Kaptajn Mands makker og Piper gør hvad hun kan for at drive Henry til vanvid hjemme i huset.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Klovn
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand forsøger at forbedre sit omdømme, ved at afholde en konkurrence, hvor man kan vinde en rundvisning af den hemmelige hule. Da vinderne bliver nogle af Henrys venner, bliver han bekymret for om hans identitet kan blive afsløret.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Spandefælden
programme.desc: Henry og Charlotte vil gerne fortælle Jasper, at Henry i virkeligheden er Faredrengen. De beslutter sig derfor for, at finde ud af om Jasper er klar til at få det at vide.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og den Slemme Pige, del 1
programme.desc: En gruppe grafittimalere overdænger Swellview med grafittitegninger. Og imens de forsøger at finde gruppens leder, bliver Faredrengen fristet af en sød pige i gruppen, der tvinger ham til at vælge imellem pigen og Kaptajn Mand.
programme.sub-title: Henry og den Slemme Pige, del 1

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og den Slemme Pige, Del 2
programme.desc: Faredrengen er gået med i grafittibanden, der spraymaler overalt i Swellview. Kaptajn Mand forsøger desperat at finde Faredrengen og Van, der er leder af gruppen.
programme.sub-title: Henry og den Slemme Pige, Del 2

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jaspers Virkelige Kæreste
programme.desc: Jaspers kæreste fra sommerlejren er kommet for at besøge ham, og hun bor hos Charlotte. Men kæresten bliver jaloux, og tror at Charlotte er forelsket i Jasper.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Rytmerne Fortsætter
programme.desc: Da Dr. Minyak vender tilbage, er Henry pludselig i fare, da den ondskabsfulde doktor har lavet hans bedste ven Charlotte om til en super stærk skabning, der skal fange Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Én Henry, tre Piger: Første del
programme.desc: Henry forsøger at fange Den Gale Bedste - en gammel bedstemor, der bliver ved med at terrorisere Kaptajn Mand i offentligheden. Det giver Henry udfordringer på både arbejds- og kærlighedsfronten.
programme.sub-title: Én Henry, tre Piger: Første del

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Henry, tre Piger: Anden Del
programme.desc: Henrys planer for Frikadelle-festen på Swellview Junior High School er komplicerede, da han bliver nødt til også at møde op som Faredrengen. Under festen sker der ting, der gør, at han må træffe en dramatisk beslutning.
programme.sub-title: En Henry, tre Piger: Anden Del

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sip of Sins
programme.desc: In the 1980s, a trio of unsolved murders occurred in Wichita Falls, Texas. Later, a fourth murder from the same time period provided the police with far more than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Partners in Crime
programme.desc: In a 1992 murder case, the autopsy of a cremated body turns up telltale clues of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Music Case
programme.desc: In 1999, a 12-year-old was found murdered in her Minnesota home. Despite a meticulous search of the home and an exhaustive investigation, police had no suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: If I Were You
programme.desc: Paul Gruber's daughter suspected something was wrong when she received birthday cards addressed from her father, but written in a stranger's handwriting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nursery Crimes
programme.desc: An investigation of a pediatrician, prompted by the mysterious death of one of her patients, leads to a Texas hospital where the pediatric mortality rate is higher than at any hospital in the country.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking News
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fired-Up
programme.desc: In 1996, Derrick Duehren returned to find his Oregon home burned to the ground. His wife's charred remains were later found in the rubble. Investigators set out to determine if it was an unfortunate accident or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purr-fect Match
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Touch of Evil
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the media dubbed Richard Rogers the "Last Call Killer" because he targeted men in gay bars who were obviously intoxicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over a Barrel
programme.desc: California police had several suspects in the robbery and brutal murder of an elderly couple. Ten years later, a determined forensic scientist used material from a dentist's office to uncover ballistic evidence that had been overlooked.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Journey to Justice
programme.desc: 6-year-old Nicole Rae Walker was killed in a hit-and-run in her Ft. Lauderdale neighborhood. The prosecutor combines the talents of an accident reconstruction expert with a video specialist to create a graphic demonstration of the moment of impact.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In 1991, Grand Junction, Colorado is on edge after a series of deadly bombings kill two people and injure one more. Police race to find the culprit before he strikes again.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Internal Affair
programme.desc: When a woman went missing, friends and family were determined to find her. Their worst fears were confirmed weeks later when her body was discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: The doctors at the hospital couldn't determine the cause of Bobby Curley's hallucinations and intense pain. They treated it as a neurological disorder but his condition deteriorated. He was being poisoned.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Line of Fire

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1987 the New Mexico Penitentiary housed hundreds of violent offenders, rapists, killers, men the juries put behind bars to protect society. On July fourth, seven of those men escaped.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
programme.desc: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1980 the FBI faced the largest explosive device they had ever seen. The bomb was sophisticated, carefully constructed, and designed to destroy an entire building.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Target
programme.desc: Over a thousand hunting accidents are reported in the United States each year. Fewer than ten percent of them are fatal. But when one hunter's death seemed suspicious, the FBI was called in to investigate.

programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Boston, FBI agents and local police tracked a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns. Their MO was familiar. The gang used precise timing to steal millions in cash and burned their getaway cars to destroy evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1970s, the FBI had a working knowledge of anti-Castro terrorists operating in the United States. But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.desc: When a victim is gunned down at point-blank range, police often assume that a friend or acquaintance is to blame.
